title: 第5章 同境内碾压云中子传授杀剑道第6章 三人行必有我师焉水中无支祈逞凶
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 才重生出世八千年，还是修炼深奥玄妙的《九转元功》，竟然能在这么快时间修炼至真心初期？
他这些年转换法力将《九转元功》修炼至第三转后期，才修炼至半步玄仙巅峰。
八千年时间里云中子就在他道场周围溜达不下十几次之多，完全处于随缘修行游山玩水，修炼进度都如此之快，实在令人惊叹啊！
也不知两人若是得知对方心思，会有什么感想。
青渊拿出自己泡的一些茶叶泡开，给云中子倒了一杯，说道：“徒儿，《青莲剑法》修炼得如何？”
“师父，此剑法我已全然摸透，反倒是《九转元功》玄妙深奥，我处于摸着石头过河的地步。”
“不错，能在这么短时间里将《青莲剑法》摸透，不愧对你的天赋。”
青渊面露欣慰，笑道：“为师想教考一下你的剑法到了什么地步，我亦用真仙境初期与你较量，如何？”
云中子犹豫一下，还是说道：“但徒儿跟脚底蕴异于寻常生灵，师父不必将境界压制于真仙境初期，徒儿完全承受得了。”
只好跟他来到楼阁外巨大的白玉广场上。
广场一隅还有棵巨大柳树迎风飘扬，见到二人便‘大老爷’、‘小老爷’的喊，让云中子多看了一眼，眼瞳微缩。
却发现柳仙并无什么不同。
手中一亮，青虹剑吞吐凌厉锋芒，温和儒雅的云中子刹那杀气腾腾，化作杀神，隐隐看到背后红砂滚滚吞没三千世界之势。
青渊随手一勾，便将柳仙身上一根枝条抓在手中。
还将境界压制到了与云中子一般的真仙境初期。
刹那间偌大的广场上铺天盖地闪烁耀眼寒芒，无数朵青光宛若骤雨覆盖着广场，荡漾着青莲的虚影，绚丽多姿中令人毛骨悚然的寒意铺天盖地降临，宛若凛冬冰寒！
content_en:
He is worthy of being the heel of the innate demon god.
It has only been 8,000 years since he was reborn, but he is still practicing the profound and mysterious "Nine Revolutions of Yuan Gong", and he can actually reach the early stage of true heart in such a short time?
He is truly worthy of being a real Immortal of Fortune!
Qingyuan felt deeply in his heart.
Come on.
Over the years, he converted his mana and practiced the "Nine Revolutions Yuan Gong" to the late third stage, and then he reached the peak of half-step Xuanxian.
There was no desertion during this period.
But the cloud neutron is better.
In the past eight thousand years, Yun Zhongzi has wandered around his dojo no less than a dozen times, completely practicing and traveling around according to circumstances. The progress of his cultivation is so fast, it is really amazing!
I don’t know how the two of them would feel if they knew each other’s thoughts.
Subsequently.
Qingyuan took out some tea leaves he had brewed, poured a cup for Yun Zhongzi, and said, "Disciple, how are you practicing the "Qinglian Sword Technique"?"
"Master, I have completely understood this sword technique. On the contrary, the "Nine Transformations of Yuan Gong" is so mysterious and profound that I am at the point of crossing the river by feeling the stones."
Yun Zhongzi told the truth.
"Yes, being able to master the "Qinglian Sword Technique" in such a short period of time is worthy of your talent."
Qingyuan looked pleased and said with a smile: "Master, I want to teach you how far your swordsmanship is. I will also compete with you in the early stage of the True Immortal Realm. How about that?"
"Master's teachings, I am very grateful, but..."
Yun Zhongzi hesitated for a moment and then said: "But the foundation of my disciple's feet is different from that of ordinary creatures. Master does not need to suppress his realm to the early stage of the True Immortal Realm. My disciple can completely bear it."
"It's okay, just let's discuss freely."
Seeing Qingyuan insist.
Yun Zhongzi could no longer dissuade him.
I had no choice but to follow him to the huge white jade square outside the pavilion.
There was also a huge willow tree fluttering in the wind in a corner of the square. When he saw the two of them, he shouted "Big Master" and "Little Master", which made Yun Zhongzi take a second look and his pupils narrowed slightly.
He stared at it for a long time.
But found that Liu Xian was no different.
I just thought I saw it wrong just now.
With a flash of light in his hand, the green rainbow sword spit out sharp edges. The gentle and elegant Yun Zhongzi suddenly became murderous and turned into a god of death. He could vaguely see the red sand rolling behind him swallowing up three thousand worlds.
"Master, this disciple has gone too far."
"Please."
Qingyuan casually hooked a branch from Liu Xian's body in his hand.
It turned out to be a sword made of willow branches.
Instead of using magic weapons.
He also suppressed his realm to the early stage of the True Immortal Realm, which is the same as Yun Neutron.
call out!
The sword light flashed.
In an instant, the huge square was covered with dazzling cold light. Countless blue lights covered the square like a shower, with the shadows of green lotuses rippling. A creepy chill amidst the gorgeous colors fell overwhelmingly, just like the freezing cold of winter!
